independence: All 18 native primary boards directly viewed before reading any lead output verdict or other reviewer findings. Original nine anchors were directly viewed earlier in this task; their hashes are bound below. Author of initial concepts; this is independent output assessment, not blind authorship.
scope: Native board novelty, adult combat identity, weapon appeal, visible contacts and whole-image framing. No complexion quality score, owner approval or sequential-motion acceptance inferred.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Strong sleek rival: platinum bob, angular white shoulder and long navy split silhouette differ from the male courier anchor.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Visible wrapped sword grip; one complete blade and both boots. Re-view confirmed crown has clear top margin.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Sword tip is sharper than the squared oblique draft; heeled boots and extra fine trim are design drift, not contact failures.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Imposing broad copper-curled protector, ivory mantle and rectangular weapon give a distinct new body and face.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One continuous shaft; closed rectangular empty frame without forbidden central strut; visible wrapped hand; complete frame and feet.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Thin frame reads partly as a ritual staff rather than a crushing hammer, an appeal tradeoff rather than broken geometry.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Open grin, golden curls, compact winding stance and green ring-weapon silhouette give lively lead appeal.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One circular blade with one crossbar gripped inside it; hand stays off the sharp outer rim. Whole weapon and feet visible.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Costume adds belts and armor accents, but no practical failure observed.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: White jagged hair, hard stare and broad low guard give a distinct feral rival compared with the copper-braided anchor.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One broad curved sword; hand wraps the handle behind the guard; blade and both boots remain in frame.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Additional costume trim is minor. Free hand reads as a deliberate claw-like guard, not an extra limb.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Rugged long-haired bearded powerhouse and rust coat are clearly combat-forward and unlike the mechanic anchor.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Two separated hands visibly wrap a continuous shaft; one connected broad glaive head and vent housing, all framed.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Pose is a low horizontal ready carry rather than the authored high carry, but remains usable and expressive.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Long brown hair and fitted navy/rust hunter silhouette create a distinct attractive pursuit fighter.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Harpoon grip is clear, but the chain terminates at the screen-left boot hardware and restarts at the other boot toward the ground ring. This reads as ankle shackles rather than one free tether. Harpoon tip touches the top image boundary.
entries.limitations_or_drift: The head also has extra barbed complexity. Weapon tip clearance and a single visibly continuous chain outside both boots need repair.

finding.target: Restore one butt-to-ring chain in one loose curve entirely clear of boots; remove all ankle attachments; leave visible margin above harpoon tip.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Slick dark hair, severe face and diagonal white/black sleeveless silhouette give a new quiet assassin.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One pointed black blade with white guard and pink slit, visibly held by its handle. Open free hand and complete feet readable.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Original noir massing remains recognizable; no concrete mechanical failure observed.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Broad muscular defender, low tied hair, armored black torso and white skirt/cape form a commanding new woman.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Large six-sided shield stays whole; fingers wrap a rear/edge handle rather than passing through the face; free fist and both boots clear.
entries.limitations_or_drift: More segmented armor than the simple draft, but strong silhouette and restrained pink accent.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Wiry adult with wild hair, sharp grin and deep lateral stance strongly conveys kinetic protagonist energy.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One gently bent staff; two distinct wrapping grips and two visible end caps. No duplicate staff; feet wholly framed.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Two red grip wraps replace the single central red zone. Small lightning cue is readable without obscuring contact.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: High tied hair, stern narrow face and strong white/black athletic silhouette make a distinct counterfighter.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One crescent blade connected to a side grip; hand visibly wraps the grip with open space from skin to blade. Whole weapon and feet.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Weapon presents more like a handheld crescent buckler than a forearm-parallel blade, but the contact and single-weapon identity remain coherent.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Golden waves, regal face and plated parchment/bronze silhouette convey an aspirational commanding rival.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One enclosed faceted mace head on one continuous shaft; visible grip and all extremities in frame.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Considerable etched ornament added, but dense copperplate handling is coherent and the main weapon contour remains legible.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Shaved side and long dark waves, broad face and asymmetric bronze shoulder create a distinctive imposing archer.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Bow grip is wrapped and each limb has three holes. String is not a single usable path through the touching hand: an almost vertical tip-to-tip line crosses diagonal hand-to-grip segments at the bright center.
entries.limitations_or_drift: This is a functional string/contact failure. Preserve face, bow silhouette and six holes while making one continuous string with one hand contact and no crossing branch.

finding.target: Replace intersecting strings with exactly one continuous tip-to-tip string touched lightly by the free fingers; no extra hand-to-grip line or central crossing.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Compact blond topknot fighter, armored broad stance and enormous beaked pick successfully replace the mundane-tool risk.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One continuous long shaft, one wrapped hand and one connected outsized curved head; whole head and both boots visible.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Head resembles a long hooked cutting beak more than a short mining pick, which supports the revised fantasy-combat direction.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Tall bob-haired woman, geometric collar and large pale Y silhouette are recognizably new and unconventional.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Base grip is readable. Drawing hand pinches a crossing band section; the stone sits in a different sagging pouch near the other forearm, away from that hand. Elastic creates an extra triangular/slack run.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Loaded weapon affordance fails: the drawing hand must hold the one stone-containing pouch joining just two tip-attached band legs.

finding.target: Keep Y frame and base grip; move the single stone-containing pouch into the drawing hand and connect it to exactly two bands, one to each fork tip; remove spare sagging run.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Huge smiling blond powerhouse and cream anchor silhouette provide clear enthusiastic lead appeal unlike the original woman.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: Single anchor has two hooks, one continuous shaft and one butt ring; firm grip; feet and full anchor visible.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Hooks are pointed rather than blunt. Close right margin is adequate; no chain or duplicate object added.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Violet wedge hair, delighted challenging expression, orange sleeves and lanky stance are energetic and distinctive.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One ball, one handle and a continuous visibly connected chain; grip and entire figure clear. Chain has at least four broad face-on links plus intervening edge-on links, exceeding the required three.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Specific topology/count drift, but the actual flail remains mechanically understandable. Lower repair priority than disconnected or misdrawn mechanisms.

finding.severity: explicit count drift; functional object retained
finding.target: Only if exact count is prioritized: shorten chain to three clearly closed interlinked links and reposition grounded ball consistently. Preserve pose, face and single-ball weapon.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Short black waves, sleeveless ivory long silhouette and enormous pale scythe differentiate him from the two-tone-haired black-clad anchor.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One continuous shaft, secure hand and one complete curved blade; both boots visible. No summoned extra figure.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Jewelry and textile filigree exceed the simplified brief and power evolution cannot be verified by a static board; neither is a grip failure.

entries.novelty_and_combat_appeal: Strawberry-blond side wave, mature face and black fitted silhouette with silver crescent create an elegant new fencer.
entries.actual_weapon_grip_framing: One straight fine blade, one dark guard, visible handle grip; tip overlaps the board divider slightly but stays within the full image. Both feet framed.
entries.limitations_or_drift: Guard is more round than teardrop. Fashion-poised rather than explosive, appropriately distinct from the exuberant candidates.

summary.do_not_fill_six_slot_budget: No reason to invent two more repairs merely to consume the allowed maximum.
summary.overall: All 18 establish visibly different new adults through face/hair, silhouette and signature weapon. Stronger combat intent than the prior civilian kit. The main practical weakness is flexible connections: chain routing, bow string and loaded sling-band contact. Static boards establish appeal and construction, not progression power performance.
